verdict.rationale: Wrike's own pricing page claims two-way syncs with 22 integrated systems, explicitly including GitHub and Jira. That directly matches keeping tasks bi-directionally synced with a code repository's issue tracker. The claim is a single marketing line, though, with no supporting detail. missing for 10: in-depth docs on sync behavior (field mapping, conflict handling, which entities sync), detail on plan tier or setup, and independent or hands-on corroboration that the GitHub sync works as described.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can keep tasks bi-directionally synced with my code repository's issue tracker instead of duplicating data

citations.quote: Set up two-way syncs between your Wrike account and 22 integrated systems, including Jira, GitHub, and more.
